comment: EPO03 PROD-WORLD-SOUTH pending regions (never a manifest). Territory 0-860 x 700-1024 (DIR-01). x,y,w,h = crop origin/size on the 1024^2 atlas; rect = authored rect in CROP coords (half-open; a coordinate outside [0,w)/[0,h) is the canvas edge, no ramp); ramps 24 free / 32 across a texture change, one-sided from the rect edge, width jittered +/-60%; inpaint = the rectangle handed to inpaint_image in crop coords (equals the rect). Salts 60-79 (SOUTH). coreAuthor where the rect enters (256..768)^2 or its rim; reauthorizes = every landmark golden the mask touches (re-extracted in the same commit, DECISIONS/0033). Storm knoll 168-264 x 816-952 is reserved for LANDMARKS: plain terrain only there.

regions.intent: The delta shore: marsh wets into grey silt in fingers, braided channels converge SE into one trunk reaching the sea through silt bars, tidal flats and creeks; the shore runs diagonally from the wooded eastern headland down toward the lower left with surf, sand, dune ridges at an angle and machair behind; one creek cuts the beach; the headland keeps its wood and its sand rim continues as a curving spit hooking south. Authors PLAINS->MARSH (apron) and COAST->SEA (Sunward shore, spit).

West of the delta: no sand where no sea reaches; sward and heath grade south into the SW wood's outliers and, near S1's dunes, into machair; the wood's straight top edge and the strand band's western run dissolve. Plain terrain over the reserved storm-knoll pocket. Authors FOREST->PLAINS at the wood's north edge and the S1 join.

The SW corner: the west shore turns from a vertical turquoise cut into a curved, diagonal coast with rock, sand and shallows; dunes and machair behind it; the wood grades into it; the lime slab goes. Paints the y=700 edge against WEST's accepted composite. Plain terrain over the reserved storm-knoll pocket.
